Normal.description: Per‑entity habitual pattern: regular login hours, consistent geo, typical resource set, sampled with noise

BruteForce.description: Rapid repeated failed‑auth attempts from one source in a short window

ImpossibleTravel.description: Same entity_id logging in from geographically distant locations within an implausible time gap

CredentialStuffing.description: Many entity_ids, few source_ips, high failure rate

LateralMovement.description: Compromised entity accesses an unusual sequence or breadth of resources it never touched before

DeviceSpoofing.description: A device_id reappearing with a mismatched fingerprint (different OS/MAC than history)

LowAndSlowExfiltration.description: Gradual, small, off‑hours resource access building up over days or weeks

InsiderDrift.description: Legitimate entity slowly expanding privilege or resource footprint — ambiguous, used for false‑positive tuning
